product_goal: ROM Shelf is a clean, intelligent Android GBA game library that automatically organizes ROMs into a beautiful cover-art grid, uses AI to identify games and find accurate artwork, eliminates duplicates, tracks save progress and recent activity, and launches any game seamlessly in the user's preferred emulator with its existing save—creating one simple, unified gaming experience.
